sun.java2d.pipe

类 NullPipe

  • java.lang.Object
    • sun.java2d.pipe.NullPipe
  • 所有已实现的接口:
    DrawImagePipe, PixelDrawPipe, PixelFillPipe, ShapeDrawPipe, TextPipe

    public class NullPipe
extends Object
implements PixelDrawPipe, PixelFillPipe, ShapeDrawPipe, TextPipe, DrawImagePipe
    This is a class that implements all of the basic pixel rendering methods as NOPs. This class is useful for installing as the pipeline when the clip is determined to be empty or when the composite operation is determined to have no effect (i.e. rule == SRC_OVER, extraAlpha == 0.0).
